title_sq: Dupleks ne shitje te Kodra e Diellit!
description_sq:
Dupleks ne shitje te Kodra e Diellit!
Dupleksi ndodhet te Kodra e Diellit 1, nje nga rezidencat me te kerkuara dhe te sigurta te Tiranes, aty ku natyra dhe qetesia behen pjese e jeteses.
Dupleksi ndodhet ne katin e dyte dhe te trete te nje objekti relativisht te ri, organizohet ne soxhorni, 3 dhoma gjumi 2 tualete, 2 ballkone dhe nje verande.
Dupleksi ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 160 m², nje siperfaqe neto prej 123 m² dhe nje verande me siperfaqe 26 m².
Ofrohet bosh, ne kete menyre jepet mundesia per ta arreduar sipas deshires.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Duplex for sale in Kodra e Diellit!
description_en: Duplex for sale in Kodra e Diellit! The duplex is located at Kodra e Diellit 1, one of the most sought-after and safe residences in Tirana, where nature and tranquility become part of life. The duplex is located on the second and third floor of a relatively new building, it is organized in living room, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies and a veranda. The duplex has a total area of ​​160 m², a net area of ​​123 m² and a veranda with an area of ​​26 m². It is offered empty, in this way it is possible to furnish it as desired. Has regular mortgage documentation.
